basis: Foundation run 40988559170 failed on npm decode-uri-component 1243857. The new high-severity advisory is remediated by an exact upstream 0.5.1 decoder backport with a pinned CommonJS compatibility adapter; no advisory or severity is suppressed.

advisories.summary: Quadratic percent-run replacement can exhaust the Node event loop.
advisories.runtime_disposition_evidence: secure_uri_decoder.py rejects unknown publisher manifests and input bytes before any write, installs the exact upstream 0.5.1 decoder body from commit 58ed85f5adc7cfaee5e49e4d52b067f172d0bcb6, and preserves the pinned CommonJS API and plus-to-space behavior through a separate adapter. Foundation and Native verify all installed copies and execute both hostile input patterns; the image build applies the same backport before asset compilation, re-verifies after build, and independently replays its receipt in the final shipped image. Package manifests and lockfiles remain unchanged, so raw version matches remain visible. See README.md and exact-head artifacts; source implementation alone is not a passing release gate.
advisories.fix_path: Retire the compatibility backport when a reviewed pinned dependency graph supports upstream ESM 0.5.1 or later; requalify every installed copy and build. New advisory IDs remain fail-closed.
